scope: Native lit MCA generation, excluding live activation; independent lookup/planner timings are not throughput claims.
build_settings: normal Cargo release: opt-level=3, thin LTO, codegen-units=2

excluded_runs.reason: Candidate copy was the stale root-level cdylib; SHA matched baseline. Excluded completely. Explicit cargo build --lib in isolated target published the compiled candidate; subsequent library SHAs differ.

decision.reason: Both Terralith full-generation pairs improve; lookup microbenchmarks improve consistently. Vanilla throughput, process RSS and tail latency remain inconclusive.
decision.remaining_validation: Combined eight-caller/lifecycle validation remains outstanding for the overall goal.
